scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @coven/web" "npm run dev -w @coven/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @coven/api && npm run build -w @coven/prover && npm run build -w @coven/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @coven/api && npm run typecheck -w @coven/prover && npm run typecheck -w @coven/web
